dizziness,lightheadedness,diplopia and vomiting since four days.H\/o Trauma one week back due to sudden hit by tailoring machine.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPatient was apparently asymptomatic one week back, then he had a history of trauma due to sudden hit by tailoring machine following which he developed pain in lumbar region radiating to both legs, dizziness,light headedness,diplopia,vomitings and headache since 5 days.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo H\/o loss of consciousness\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo H\/o involuntary movements\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo H\/o slurring speech and blurred vision\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo H\/o of seizures\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo H\/o weakness in limbs\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo H\/o bowel and bladder incontinence\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo H\/o syncopal attacks, palpitation, shortness of breath\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo H\/o fever, loose stools, cough, cold\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo H\/o tinnitus,ear pain and aural fullness\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cu\u003EPAST HISTORY:-\u003C\/u\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u0026nbsp; standing and squating due to pain she was told she has some kidney issue and after three days there was abdominal distension also associated with fever loss of appetite and myalgias.Then she used
